facts.business: Tega Industries Limited manufactures and supplies consumables and equipment for the mining, mineral processing, and material handling industries, including mill liners, screen panels, and conveyor components.

capacity_or_capex.item: Greenfield Project, Additional Patent, Commissioned SEZ unit in Dahej, Gujarat

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matter: Impairment Assessment on carrying value of equity investments in Tega Holdings Pte Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary (Refer note 4 of the standalone financial statements)
